newsitem.title: USA: JumboSports says extends credit facility.
newsitem.headline: JumboSports says extends credit facility.

text.p: JumboSports Inc said Thursday its bank group has agreed to extend its revolving credit facility through May, 1999.

JumboSports said the agreement incorporates additional capital expenditure flexibility to allow it to continue with new store development, renovate selected locations and complete upgrades of its infrastructure.

The company, a retailer of name brand sporting equipment and athletic footwear and apparel, reported a first quarter loss per share of $0.07 compared to a loss of $0.02 per share for the same period a year ago.
